title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file (pure-insertion diff failure on .moeb/README.md)
description: All pure-insertion patch_file attempts against .moeb/README.md failed with 'All context lines appear in the file — check removed lines' despite context lines matching exactly. A remove-and-restore workaround succeeded but inadvertently erased the blank line between ### vcs and the vcs domain table.
proposed_resolution: Investigate patch_file.rs apply path for pure-insertion hunks. Confirm diffy handles patches with no removed lines. Also restore the blank line between ### vcs and the vcs table in .moeb/README.md.
